author: NotaRealVet
body:
summon scrolls will never exceed your tier. There are limited year round raids you can summon and some event ones. if you are at tier 9, you cannot summon a tier 10 raid

you can use the circle menu on the top right of your screen in the overworld to check out what event is running this month. Through that you can see if there's any event raids for the month.

some monthly raids can only be summoned by crafting special summoning scrolls with special materials at the monument guild.
